_what: Production routes a variation's recipe may name, with the rate the machine multiplies. The recipe stage (5) names a route id and the units; the machine does the arithmetic from this file, so a price change is one edit here and never a prompt edit. Rates are research facts from the Model Map v1 (27 Sep 2026) and the locked choices (GPT Image direct via OpenAI; Seedance on Higgsfield; editing jobs on the local studio).
